newsitem.title: UK: UK's Knight says data good news for retail prices.
newsitem.headline: UK's Knight says data good news for retail prices.

text.p: The British Treasury's economic secretary, Angela Knight, said producer price figures on Monday signaled good news for consumer prices in the future.

"Inflation at the factory gate is at its lowest for almost 30 years," Knight said in a statement read by a Treasury official. "Today's low inflation at the factory gate is tomorrow's good news for prices in the shops."

November producer output prices were unchanged from the prior month and were 2.1 percent higher than a year earlier. Seasonally adjusted input prices fell 3.2 percent in the month and were down 5.5 percent in the year.
The input price fall was much deeper than expected, with markets looking for a 0.8 percent fall in the month and a 2.6 percent drop in the year.
Economists on average expected a 0.1 percent November rise in output prices, with the range of forecasts running from flat to 0.3 percent higher.
